Dispatch it to its owner agent (or the right agent if unassigned), oversee the work, and verify the result. If and only if the work is fully complete and verified, update this exact task to review with todo_tasks. If the work is incomplete, interrupted, or fails, do not change its status; it must remain progress. During this run, never set it to blocked or done. Then stop; the auto-advance loop continues with the next task on its own.
